title: A habit that still shows up on AI-built apps: the session token sits in localStorage so any script on the page can read it. Prefer an HttpOn
content_md:
A habit that still shows up on AI-built apps: the session token sits in localStorage so any script on the page can read it. Prefer an HttpOn
